class.name: VoxelBlockRegistry
class.brief_description: Resource that assigns textures and optional shaders to engine-defined block types for [VoxelWorld].
class.description: A registry used by [VoxelWorld]. Each block type is defined at the engine level (in VoxelBlockData) with its name, color, solidity, and transparency. This resource allows assigning per-face textures (top, side, bottom) and an optional [ShaderMaterial] to those block types from the editor. When a block has a [ShaderMaterial] assigned, all its faces are rendered with that shader instead of the default [StandardMaterial3D]. The block's primary texture is automatically set as the [code]texture_albedo[/code] shader parameter. Shader authors should declare [code]uniform sampler2D texture_albedo;[/code] in their [code].gdshader[/code] file to receive the block texture. When no registry is assigned to a [VoxelWorld], one is created automatically with entries for all built-in block types (no textures or shaders assigned, vertex colors used).

method.name: create_block
method.description: Creates a new texture entry for the given block ID. Does nothing if the entry already exists.

method.name: remove_block
method.description: Removes the texture entry for the given block ID.

method.name: has_block
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a texture entry with the given block ID exists.

method.name: get_block_list
method.description: Returns an array of all registered block IDs.

method.name: get_block_count
method.description: Returns the number of registered block entries.

method.name: set_block_texture_top
method.description: Sets the texture for the top face (+Y) of the block.

method.name: get_block_texture_top
method.description: Returns the texture assigned to the top face of the block.

method.name: set_block_texture_side
method.description: Sets the texture for the side faces of the block.

method.name: get_block_texture_side
method.description: Returns the texture assigned to the side faces of the block.

method.name: set_block_texture_bottom
method.description: Sets the texture for the bottom face (-Y) of the block.

method.name: get_block_texture_bottom
method.description: Returns the texture assigned to the bottom face of the block.

method.name: block_has_texture
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the block has any texture assigned (top, side, or bottom).

method.name: setup_defaults
method.description: Populates the registry with entries for all built-in block types (Air, Grass, Dirt, Stone, Sand, Water, Snow, Wood, Leaves, Bedrock). No textures are assigned; blocks will use engine-defined vertex colors by default.

method.name: set_block_shader_material
method.description: Sets the [ShaderMaterial] for the block. When set, all faces of this block type are rendered with this shader instead of the default material. The block's primary texture is automatically passed as the [code]texture_albedo[/code] shader parameter.

method.name: get_block_shader_material
method.description: Returns the [ShaderMaterial] assigned to the block, or [code]null[/code] if none is set.

method.name: block_has_shader
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the block has a [ShaderMaterial] assigned.
